result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visual defects: misaligned cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, clipped/truncated content at the right edge, and a partially cut-off category chip. Most issues are layout-related and affect visual polish rather than core functionality.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are vertically misaligned: the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card image starts lower than the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards, causing uneven baselines for restaurant names and delivery prices.
issues.suggestion: Use a fixed image height and consistent top alignment for all carousel cards so images, titles, and prices line up on the same rows.

issues.description: The third carousel item's name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' with the card cut off at the screen edge without a proper truncation treatment (no ellipsis).
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis for overflowing names and add right padding or a peek/fade effect to clearly indicate the carousel scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or add an edge fade/partial-peek design so the cut-off chip clearly reads as scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image has visibly different padding/aspect ratio (plate floats on a light gray background) compared to the full-bleed images of adjacent cards, making the row look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image treatment (full-bleed, same aspect ratio and corner radius) across all cards in the carousel.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the tab bar with only the '-20%' badge and favorite icon visible, and no restaurant details shown.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scroll container has adequate bottom padding so partially visible cards are clearly scroll-continuations, or reduce card height so key info isn't hidden behind the bottom navigation.
